notes: Evidence covers mainly the Washington (Tacoma) refinery; capacity, utilization and complexity come from general knowledge of the multi-refinery system, stated qualitatively.

refining_related_activity.value: Crude-oil refining across several regional refineries, plus asphalt production, marine fuels, terminals and logistics, and retail marketing

crude_processing_capacity_refineries.value: Multi-refinery system in Hawaii, Washington, Wyoming and Montana; combined capacity is mid-sized, with each refinery small to mid-scale

product_yield_mix.value: Transportation-fuel-led output: gasoline, ultra-low-sulfur diesel, jet fuel and marine fuels, plus paving and industrial asphalt

feedstock_specification.value: Mix of light and medium crudes, including Bakken Blend, Alaska North Slope and Cold Lake blend (heavy)

margin_crack_spread_exposure.value: Regional crack spreads (Pacific Northwest, Hawaii, Rocky Mountain) and crude-quality differentials in logistically complex markets

conversion_refinery_complexity.value: Mix of hydroskimming and moderate-complexity conversion refineries, with some cracking units
